requirements: Is there exactly one object shown?
Is the object a pair of enormous dark grey riveted steel soundstage sliding doors?
Are there yellow and black hazard stripes along the bottom of the doors?
Are the doors slid wide apart to both sides with the middle of the doorway open?
Does the open doorway show a dark soundstage interior with a few warm work lights?
Is there a round red warning lamp above the doors that is switched off with dark red glass and no glow?
Is there no sign present on or near the object?
Is the object about two people wide and about three people tall?
Is the object centered with a clear margin around it and fully inside the picture?
Is there only a small soft contact shadow directly under the object with no other scenery?
